metadata.title: Tender Sourcing Plan (TSP)
metadata.description: Agent-guided sourcing plan and experiment tracker for open tenders.

steps.speaker: Procurement PM
steps.message: Open the tender sourcing plan and show which RFPs still need clarifications this week.

steps.speaker: Cockpit Agent
steps.message: Loaded the plan. Here is the active tender snapshot with owners and deadlines.

steps.speaker: Procurement PM
steps.message: Draft a response to vendors who are late and tag the delivery team for pricing review.

steps.speaker: Cockpit Agent
steps.message: On it. I will notify the owners, publish the reply in the portal, and propose a pricing huddle for tomorrow.
